findings.title: Multipart audio transcription requests are rejected before routing Priority: Medium
findings.label: bug
findings.body:
## Summary

The registered `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` route still extracts the requested model exclusively from the JSON request-head scanner. A standard OpenAI multipart request has a form field named `model`, not a top-level JSON object, so the relay returns HTTP 400 before resolving a route or contacting an upstream.

## Impact

Normal multipart transcription clients cannot use the advertised audio-transcription endpoint. This is a deterministic request-shape failure, independent of provider credentials or availability.

## Evidence

- [Route registration](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L168) sends the endpoint through `dispatch_openai`.
- [Request-head scan](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L945) calls `scan_request_head(&bytes)`.
- [Model resolution](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L1004) returns 400 when `requested_model` is absent.
- [The helper](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L3417) returns only `head.model_str(body)`.
- [The scanner](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/model_scan.rs#L113) scans a JSON request head; it does not parse multipart form fields.
- The API route is documented as [multipart](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/docs/24-provider-dialects.md#L833).

## Reproduction / verification

Send a normal `multipart/form-data` POST to `/v1/audio/transcriptions` with a `model` form field and a small `file` part. Static tracing shows the model scanner produces no model and `dispatch_routed` returns its “request body has no readable model field” 400 before route resolution. No live provider was contacted.

## Expected behavior

The relay should extract the model from the multipart form under the existing request-size limit and preserve the original multipart body and boundary for compatible upstream passthrough. Unsupported cross-dialect audio translation should fail explicitly rather than being treated as a chat-shaped JSON body.

## Acceptance criteria

- Resolve the multipart `model` field without rewriting or buffering unbounded data.
- Preserve the original body bytes and multipart boundary on a compatible OpenAI-style upstream.
- Define and document behavior for non-OpenAI dialects that cannot accept this audio route.

## Regression tests

- Add a relay integration test posting multipart `model` plus a small file to a mock upstream and assert the request reaches it.
- Assert the upstream receives the original content type, boundary, and body bytes.
- Assert unsupported dialects return a clear capability error rather than attempting chat translation.
- Keep JSON model extraction and body-size-limit tests passing.

findings.title: Keyless Bearer requests reopen the vault on every attempt Priority: Medium
findings.label: bug
findings.body:
## Summary

A deliberately keyless Bearer account still reaches the vault-refresh path on every request. `account_credential` calls `stored_credential`; when the conventional slot is empty, `stored_credential` calls `Vault::refreshed()`, which reopens the vault from disk before returning the expected missing-slot result.

## Impact

For a valid local Bearer provider whose account intentionally has no credential, each attempt performs synchronous filesystem reads and vault parsing on the relay request path. This adds avoidable latency and can block a Tokio worker, contrary to the startup-open vault design. The empty slot is expected to remain empty, so this is a hot path rather than a rare recovery path.

## Evidence

- [Credential lookup](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L1713) calls `app.vault.get(id)`.
- [Every empty lookup refreshes](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L1722) by calling `app.vault.refreshed()`.
- [Keyless-account classification](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L1776) identifies the compiler's conventional fallback slot as an account with no own credential.
- [Per-attempt resolution](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L2048) calls `account_credential` while building each attempt's candidates.
- [Vault refresh](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/mr-core/src/secret.rs#L224) delegates to `Self::open(dir)`, which rereads the key and vault files.

## Reproduction / verification

Configure a Bearer provider with an account that has no credential of its own, then send repeated requests. The account resolves to its conventional empty slot; each call to `stored_credential` observes `Ok(None)` and refreshes the vault before `account_credential` returns the valid credential-less state. This is a static call-path finding; no production filesystem tracing was performed.

## Expected behavior

A known intentionally empty keyless slot should not trigger a synchronous vault reopen on every attempt. Credentials added after startup must still become visible through an explicit invalidation or bounded refresh policy.

## Acceptance criteria

- Repeated keyless requests do not reopen or reparse the vault for every attempt.
- Credentials added while the relay is running become visible through a documented cache-invalidation, file-version, or bounded-refresh mechanism.
- Vault read/decryption errors remain distinct from an ordinary missing secret and fail closed.

## Regression tests

- Inject or instrument the vault loader and assert repeated keyless requests do not repeatedly refresh it.
- Verify a credential written after startup becomes visible after the chosen invalidation mechanism.
- Keep the existing keyless Bearer and keyed-empty-slot tests passing.

findings.title: Combo editor exposes an ignored affinity field as message merging Priority: Low
findings.label: bug
findings.body:
## Summary

The Combo editor labels a toggle “Merge identical consecutive messages when translating between dialects”, but it reads and writes `draft.affinity`. The model defines `Combo.affinity` as “whether the relay keeps the winning step sticky for a conversation”; it is not a message-merging setting. The field is compiled into the snapshot, but the relay's sticky-success selection uses `hedge.enabled` and `sticky_success_window_secs` and does not read `ComboPlan.affinity`.

## Impact

The UI promises a translation behavior that the field does not represent. Operators can save a setting that has no runtime effect, while believing they enabled message merging. This is both a UI/backend contract mismatch and an accepted-but-ignored configuration field.

## Evidence

- [Misleading UI label](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/panel/view-combos.js#L1048) creates the toggle with the message-merging description.
- [Serialized property](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/panel/view-combos.js#L1110) is `affinity: affinity.checked`.
- [Model meaning](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/mr-core/src/model.rs#L1279) defines affinity as keeping the winning step sticky for a conversation.
- [Snapshot field](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/mr-core/src/snapshot.rs#L309) carries the field into `ComboPlan`.
- The relay's [sticky-success predicate](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L3304) bases runtime selection on strategy and the sticky-success window; the relay has no read of `combo.affinity`.

## Reproduction / verification

Open a combo in the panel and inspect the Delivery toggle. Its checked state comes from `draft.affinity`; saving writes `affinity: affinity.checked`. Trace the relay's `sticky_applies` predicate and request path: the serialized field is not consulted. Static UI-to-model-to-runtime tracing only; no browser session was run.

## Expected behavior

Every visible setting must describe the field it edits and have a real runtime effect. If session affinity is not implemented, the editor must not present the field as an active message-merging feature.

## Acceptance criteria

- Either implement and test the intended session-affinity behavior end to end, or remove/disable the unused field.
- Rename the UI control to an accurate session-affinity label if that behavior is implemented.
- If message merging is intended, define a separate schema field and implement its translation behavior rather than reusing `affinity`.

## Regression tests

- Add a panel test asserting the accessible label matches the serialized property.
- Add a config/snapshot/relay contract test proving the field changes the intended runtime selection.
- If the field is removed, assert the panel no longer serializes it.

findings.title: README still lists bounded same-step account retry as unimplemented Priority: Low
findings.label: documentation
findings.body:
## Summary

The README Status section still lists “per-account retry inside a single request” as a known gap, but the current relay has a bounded same-step account-retry loop.

## Impact

The project status is misleading for operators evaluating multi-account fallback. It understates behavior already present in the request path and disagrees with the implementation.

## Evidence

- [README status claim](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/README.md#L279) still lists per-account retry as unimplemented.
- [Retry budget](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L1235) bounds retries by sibling-account count (capped at eight).
- [Retry condition and repeated attempt](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L1248) retry only when the failure is marked retryable and another account remains live.

## Reproduction / verification

Static trace of `dispatch_routed` confirms that retryable account failures cool the account, re-resolve candidates for the same step, and retry within a bounded loop before falling through to the next step. This is not a retry for malformed requests or every upstream status.

## Expected behavior

The README should describe bounded same-step retry and its eligibility conditions rather than saying the feature is absent.

## Acceptance criteria

- Update the README Status section to describe same-step retry for retryable account failures, including its bound and exclusions.
- Keep the implementation-status document aligned with the README's status summary.

## Regression tests

- Keep relay tests for same-step account retry and failure exclusions green.
- Include a test proving a retryable failure on one account can be served by a sibling account.

findings.title: WinnerFailMode comments still claim implemented recovery modes are unimplemented Priority: Low
findings.label: documentation
findings.body:
## Summary

The model comment and a core enum test still say winner recovery and three non-default `WinnerFailMode` variants are unimplemented, while the current implementation-status document and relay dispatch implement all four modes.

## Impact

Maintainers reading the model and enum test are given the opposite status from the runtime. This can cause incorrect refactors, missed test coverage, and misleading implementation-status decisions.

## Evidence

- [Combo model comment](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/mr-core/src/model.rs#L1262) says winner recovery and the mid-stream switch are not implemented.
- [WinnerFailMode test comment](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/mr-core/src/dialect.rs#L1313) says the other three variants are not implemented.
- [Different-provider recovery](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L3145) filters replacement participants by provider.
- [Rerun and stable-fallback setup](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/server.rs#L3165) builds the rerun budget for the two modes that dispatch new work.
- [Recovery body](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/crates/manarouter-relay/src/recovery.rs#L590) returns `NeedRerun` for the configured rerun modes.
- [Implementation status](https://github.com/RobertoTornel/Manarouter/blob/1ba954eaa76f2aecba936f3f9001c21470d274d2/docs/23-implementation-status.md#L53) states that all four modes are implemented.

## Reproduction / verification

Read the model/test comments alongside the relay's `run_hedge` setup and `RecoveryBody::fail`. The runtime has distinct handling for `PickHighestPassedDifferentProvider`, `RerunExcluding`, and `StableFallback`, contrary to the comments. This is a static control-flow verification; no local tests were run.

## Expected behavior

Comments and tests should describe the current implementation. Each mode's behavior should be pinned by a test rather than a comment that says it is unimplemented.

## Acceptance criteria

- Update the stale `Combo.hedge` documentation in `model.rs`.
- Correct the `WinnerFailMode` test comment and ensure its test name/body describe what it actually verifies.
- Keep the implementation-status documentation and source comments consistent.

## Regression tests

- Test `PickHighestPassedDifferentProvider` excludes the failed winner's provider.
- Test `RerunExcluding` performs bounded re-dispatch after a committed winner fails.
- Test `StableFallback` dispatches only the nominated step.
- Retain tests for tool-call and mid-frame refusal boundaries.
